preservation: Facade charts preserve the original municipal geometry, winding, unrelated UVs, textures and collision. Entrance geometry is separately recorded in senate-entrances.json.
scope: Aleksanterinkatu 14-18 north front, Rauhankatu 17 south front, Porthania public south courtyard and east frontage.
limitations: Unobserved side, rear and roof surfaces remain original. Snellmaninkatu rear annex remains unresolved. Original authored dimensions approximate the inspected architecture; no survey accuracy is claimed.
